# From script to functions {#sec-from-script}

This is the session where we do the whole thing, on a real script, from one end to the other. We start with a hundred lines that work and nobody wants to touch, and we finish with a folder of named functions and a script thin enough to read in one go.

::: {.overview}

## Overview {.unnumbered}

**Duration** 60 minutes

**Questions**

- Where do I even start with a script this long?
- How do I break code into ideas rather than lines?
- How do I extract functions without breaking what works?
- Where do the functions live once I have them?

**What you need this session**

- A session of RStudio open
- The script we will work on, or one of your own

:::
